findings.description: Elsa Brita Heikkinen was born in May 1832, according to the 1851-1860 church census (communion book) of Iisalmi rural parish, which lists her in the village of Kilpisaari; the index gives no birthplace, so the place is the parish of the entry.
supporting_sources: Finland, Church Census and Pre-Confirmation Books, 1600-1916 — entry for Elsa Brita Heickinen, Kilpisaari, Iisalmen maalaiskunta, 1851-1860
